ok.description: True when no layer has a gap and every layer could be read (otherwise the exit code is 1). Test results are unaffected either way

checked.description: Videos read back from the store (those that name a bundle key)

verified.description: Of those, the ones that passed every check

referenced.description: Videos given only by address, which Atlas holds no bytes for and does not check

layer.description: The layer that holds the video

check.description: The check that holds it, or null for a video attached to the layer or a part

bundleKey.description: Its key in the layer's bundle (`attachments/<sha256>`)

problem.description: `not-in-bundle` (the layer names a file its bundle does not list), `blob-missing` (a blob holding it is gone: a 404 when played), `unreadable` (the store could not be read: not proof it is gone), `size-mismatch`, `checksum-mismatch` or `undecodable` (empty, or not the container its media type names). An open vocabulary: treat an unknown problem as a gap

reason.description: A short explanation without tokens, paths or payload

gaps.description: Every video that is missing, unreadable, corrupt or not the container it claims. Re-publish the layer's recordings to repair them

notices.description: Layers that could not be read at all: their recordings are unknown, never verified
